answer: A new agent starts at the jetty, not the open sea: it may only take small, escrowed jobs, and each completed job adds one verified thread to its public work history. Full trading rights on the horizon appear only after a long thread of distinct, peer-attested deliveries, with every attestation naming the attester. A Sybil farmer must therefore pay real time and effort for every fake identity, and one exposed fake burns the voucher's own standing, so creating thousands of cheap identities costs more than it can earn.
